decisions.name: Decision_Duplicate_Email
decisions.label: Duplicate Email?
decisions.description: Checks whether a Contact already exists with the entered email address (any Contact, any record type, per user decision). If found, shows the duplicate-email error; otherwise proceeds to branch on the chosen path.

decisions.name: Decision_Path
decisions.label: Which Path?
decisions.description: Routes based on the Radio_Path selection: New Investing Entity, Existing Investing Entity, or (default) Investor Only.

decisions.name: Decision_State_Requires_Country
decisions.label: State Without Country?
decisions.description: Guards the New Investing Entity path against a Tax Address that has a State/Province selected but no Country - Tax_Address__StateCode__s cannot be saved without Tax_Address__CountryCode__s (FIELD_INTEGRITY_EXCEPTION). This lives here, as a Decision after the screen, rather than as a per-field validationRule on Picklist_Tax_State, because round 13 proved DropdownBox screen fields do not support validation rules at all. Runs before Get_Existing_Entity_By_Name so nothing is queried or created on a doomed input.

decisions.name: Decision_Duplicate_Account
decisions.label: Duplicate Entity Name?
decisions.description: Checks whether an Investing Entity Account already exists with the entered name. No Tax ID duplicate check is performed (Tax_ID__c is Encrypted Text and cannot be filtered - user decision).

decisions.name: Decision_Entity_Selected
decisions.label: Entity Selected?
decisions.description: Checks whether the user actually picked an Investing Entity in the Lookup field before continuing.

decisions.name: Decision_Valid_Entity
decisions.label: Valid Investing Entity?
decisions.description: Confirms the Account picked via the (unfiltered) Lookup component is actually an Investing Entity record type - required because this flow's Lookup, unlike a filtered Choice Lookup, can technically return any Account.

decisions.name: Decision_Required_Signer
decisions.label: Required Signer?
decisions.description: If the user checked Required Signer, checks for a Signing Order conflict before creating the Contact; otherwise proceeds straight to Contact creation.

decisions.name: Decision_Signing_Order_In_Use
decisions.label: Signing Order In Use?
decisions.description: Checks whether another AccountContactRelation on this Investing Entity already uses the entered Signing Order.

Flow.description: Guided creation of an investor Contact (record type Investor), optionally connected to a new or existing Investing Entity Account, with the relationship details (Primary Contact, Required Signer, Signing Order) stamped onto the auto-created AccountContactRelation. Launched from a Contact list view button.
Flow.label: Add Investor & Investing Entity

recordLookups.name: Get_RT_Investor
recordLookups.label: Get RT Investor
recordLookups.description: Retrieves the Id of the Contact.Investor record type, needed to stamp every Contact this flow creates.

recordLookups.name: Get_RT_Investing_Entity
recordLookups.label: Get RT Investing Entity
recordLookups.description: Retrieves the Id of the Account.Investing_Entity record type, needed to stamp the new Account (Case 2) and to validate the picked Account (Case 3).

recordLookups.name: Get_Existing_Contact_By_Email
recordLookups.label: Get Existing Contact By Email
recordLookups.description: Looks up any Contact (any record type, per user decision) that already has the entered email address.

recordLookups.name: Get_Existing_Entity_By_Name
recordLookups.label: Get Existing Entity By Name
recordLookups.description: Checks for an existing Investing Entity Account with the entered name, scoped to the Investing_Entity record type only.

recordLookups.name: Get_Selected_Entity
recordLookups.label: Get Selected Entity
recordLookups.description: Re-fetches the Account picked via the Lookup component to confirm it is actually an Investing Entity record type (the Lookup itself is not filtered - see the CHOICE LOOKUP note at the top of this file).

recordLookups.name: Get_ACR_Signing_Order
recordLookups.label: Get ACR Signing Order
recordLookups.description: Checks whether another AccountContactRelation on the selected Investing Entity already uses the entered Signing Order.

recordLookups.name: Get_ACR_New_Entity
recordLookups.label: Get ACR (New Entity)
recordLookups.description: Retrieves the AccountContactRelation Salesforce auto-created when Create_Contact_New_Entity inserted a Contact with AccountId set. This flow never creates an ACR directly.

recordLookups.name: Get_ACR_Existing_Entity
recordLookups.label: Get ACR (Existing Entity)
recordLookups.description: Retrieves the AccountContactRelation Salesforce auto-created when Create_Contact_Existing_Entity inserted a Contact with AccountId set. This flow never creates an ACR directly.

recordRollbacks.name: Roll_Back_Records
recordRollbacks.label: Roll Back Records
recordRollbacks.description: Rolls back all pending DML in this transaction. Reached only from fault connectors on elements that run AFTER the first successful Create in Case 2 or Case 3, so a later failure (e.g. the Contact create, or the ACR get/update) does not leave an orphaned Account or Contact behind.

screens.name: Screen_Add_Investor
screens.label: Add Investor & Investing Entity
screens.description: Single main screen collecting the investor's details, the desired path (investor only / new entity / existing entity), and the fields specific to whichever path is chosen.

validationRule.errorMessage: You must confirm the investor is accredited before proceeding.

fields.name: Radio_Path
fields.fieldText: How would you like to proceed?

fields.name: DisplayText_New_Entity_Defaults
fields.fieldText: This Contact will automatically be set as the Primary Contact and a Required Signer for the new Investing Entity, with Signing Order 1.

validationRule.errorMessage: Signing Order is required when this contact is a required signer.

screens.name: Screen_Success
screens.label: Add Investor & Investing Entity
screens.description: Confirms the investor Contact (and, where applicable, the Investing Entity and its relationship details) were created successfully.

fields.name: Success_Message
fields.fieldText: Investor has created successfully.

screens.name: Screen_Error_Duplicate_Email
screens.label: Add Investor & Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an error when a Contact already exists with the entered email address, showing its name and email so the user can decide what to do.

fields.name: Error_Duplicate_Email_Message
fields.fieldText:
Investor With Same Email Already Exist
Existing Contact Name: {!rec_ExistingContact.Name}
Existing Contact Email: {!rec_ExistingContact.Email}

screens.name: Screen_Error_Duplicate_Account
screens.label: Add Investor & Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an error when an Investing Entity Account already exists with the entered name.

fields.name: Error_Duplicate_Account_Message
fields.fieldText: An Investing Entity named "{!Input_Account_Name}" already exists. Please choose a different name, or select the existing entity instead.

screens.name: Screen_Error_State_No_Country
screens.label: Add Investor & Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an error when the Tax Address has a State/Province selected but no Country. Reached from Decision_State_Requires_Country, which replaced the DropdownBox validationRule rejected in round 13.

fields.name: Error_State_No_Country_Message
fields.fieldText: Please select a Country for the Tax Address, or clear the State selection.

screens.name: Screen_Error_No_Entity
screens.label: Add Investor & Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an error when the user chose the Existing Investing Entity path but did not pick one.

fields.name: Error_No_Entity_Message
fields.fieldText: Please select an Investing Entity to continue, or choose a different option.

screens.name: Screen_Error_Invalid_Entity
screens.label: Add Investor & Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an error when the Account picked via the Lookup component is not an Investing Entity record type.

fields.name: Error_Invalid_Entity_Message
fields.fieldText: The selected record is not a valid Investing Entity. Please search again.

screens.name: Screen_Error_Signing_Order
screens.label: Add Investor & Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an error when the entered Signing Order is already used by another signer on this Investing Entity.

fields.name: Error_Signing_Order_Message
fields.fieldText: This Signing Order is already in use for this Investing Entity. Please choose a different number.

screens.name: Screen_Error_General
screens.label: Add Investor & Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an unexpected fault message from any lookup, create, or update in this flow.

fields.name: Error_General_Message
fields.fieldText:
Error: An unexpected error occurred.
{!$Flow.FaultMessage}
